title: Improving Sleep Health for Asian Americans
official: Pilot Testing a Sleep Intervention Among Filipino American Adults
summary: Filipino Americans are at high risk of poor sleep and its adverse health consequences. The goal of this study is to test a generative AI-powered chatbot that delivers personalized, evidence-based sleep education and guidance to Filipino Americans who experience poor sleep.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 30 to 70 years
* Self-identify as having a Filipino background and reside in the United States
* Poor sleep quality, defined as a Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI) score ≥ 5
* Short sleep duration, defined as an average Fitbit-measured total sleep time \< 7 hours/night over 7 days
* Able to speak and read English
* Willing to engage with the chatbot via text messaging

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe mental disorders, including major depressive symptoms
* Medical conditions, including cognitive impairment, that may interfere with the ability to follow study procedures
* Current participation in another lifestyle intervention
* Night-shift or rotating-shift worker
* Alcohol or substance abuse
* Use of sleep medications more than 3 times per week
